title: Catalog of vQTLs and GxEs for cardiometabolic biomarkers
bodyHtml:
This page contains summary statistics for the UK Biobank vQTL and GxE associations described in:

Variance-quantitative trait loci enable systematic discovery of gene-environment interactions for cardiometabolic serum biomarkers.
Westerman KE et al.
Nat Commun. 2022 Jul 9;13(1):3993. doi: 10.1038/s41467-022-31625-5.
PMID: 35810165

Use the tabs above to navigate through our results, or download the full set of vQTL and GxE meta-analysis summary statistics here; (4.4GB zipped file).

Contact:

  • Kenny Westerman: kewesterman(at)mgh.harvard.edu
  • Joanne Cole: jcole(at)broadinstitute.org
projectSummary: Interactively explore and download summary statistics for variance-QTLs and gene-environment interactions for cardiometabolic serum biomarkers.
